title: 1944 press reports of silver spheres over Germany

tellings.quote: there's a whole bunch of stories in 1944 Newsweek ran the silver sphere sp puzzle um Christmas day in 1944 Associated Press balls of silver scene over the German Reich intrigue science

plain: A researcher named Merrick says that in 1944, during the Second World War, newspapers reported strange silver spheres in the sky over Germany. He points to a Newsweek magazine piece called "The Silver Sphere Puzzle" and an Associated Press news wire story on Christmas Day 1944 about balls of silver seen over the German Reich, which would show such sightings were being reported before the modern UFO era began.
